race.comment: SCOOP THE POOL (1) is more of a staying type who has gotten out well beyond this journey. He led at Nowra and was run down. Could well be looking for more ground in time. LANDING GEAR (2) put in two decent efforts so far. He hasn't been forward in either of them. Maybe the gate won't allow that but the longer race will help. INFINITE SKY (10) caught the eye late first up at big odds and with further improvement expected, she has to be included in the main chances. Stablemate CADMEAN (5) looks set to relish the step up in trip and appears the next in line.
